title: Mochizuki Honami — Welcome To The Nightmare〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
How about that one?
Phenny's Nightmare!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's a haunted house, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! It's a little dark and creepy just like its name suggests!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, let's go inside☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So this is the fun sort of haunted house that you and Tsukasa were talking about...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! It's really fun, I promise♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It looks like your standard haunted house from the outside, but they're saying it's not scary at all so... I should be okay, right?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, it says here to go inside two at a time.
Should we split into pairs?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! I'll go with you, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yeah, okay.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, the two scaredy cats are going together...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Don't worry♪ It's a family-friendly attraction.
That means it's okay for kids too, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So there can't be anything in there that would frighten high schoolers like us!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Someone's feeling brave, aren't they?
Don't run to me crying to me afterwards.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I thought Shiho seemed a bit down just now, but maybe it was just me...)

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Alright, is the next pair ready to go in?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yes, we are♪
Let's go, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It's a family-friendly attraction... It's fine... I'll be fine!)

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line:
Eeek! A skeleton!
Get away! Get away!

rows.Speaker: Honami's Voice
rows.Line: Noooo! Don't come this way...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Are they really going to be okay?
They're screaming so loud, I can hear them out here...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That must be because they're having sooo much fun! This haunted house is one of my favorites, so I'm super glad!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
How can you say that when they're SCREAMING?!
Saki! Honami! Are you okay?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Are you okay, Honami?
Here, have some juice.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thanks, Shiho.
Where did Saki go...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She went to ride the teacups one more time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see. Everyone's so energetic...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess that haunted house really took its toll on you, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho, you meanie...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Hmm...I guess I was just imagining things...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, um... That haunted house was really scary, wasn't it?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really? I thought you and Saki screaming was the only scary part.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I didn't even know you could be that loud.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: W-Was it really that bad?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If recording videos wasn't prohibited, I might've saved even just the soundtrack of what happened.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, thank goodness you can't do that here...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I must have been wrong about her.
She seems like she's enjoying herself.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki and the rest of the bunch should be back soon.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right. Let's go then!
